draft_en.subject: OEM supply for the NSC PoE switch range
draft_en.body:
Hello,

TURM sells PoE switches under the NSC Videotechnik label - the 24-port with 2 uplinks and 2 SFP, for example. That is exactly the kind of product we build for security brands in Europe: PoE switches with the brand's logo, web UI and carton, CE/RoHS/REACH, no MOQ, 8 to 48 ports, unmanaged or L2 managed, with 10G-uplink options on the managed side.

If the NSC range is sourced externally, I would be glad to send a spec-by-spec proposal against your current 24-port and 8-port models with pricing.

Who on your side looks after NSC hardware sourcing - may I write to them directly?

Simon
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com

notes: 不猜他们现在的供应商。
